title: Scalar-linear tensor-section transport along an open immersion
statement: Let k be a field, f:X→Spec k and g:Y→Spec k structure morphisms, and a:Y→X an open immersion with a≫f=g. Let U be an open of X whose inverse image is all of Y and which is contained in the image of a. For any O_X-modules M,N, O_Y-modules M′,N′ and coefficient isomorphisms a* M≅M′ and a* N≅N′, there is a k-linear isomorphism (M⊗N)(U)≅Γ(Y,M′⊗N′) carrying every tensor section s⊗t to the tensor of the two pullback-unit sections, followed by the supplied coefficient maps. Pullback-unit sections are the adjunction unit on U followed by restriction to Y. The scalar objects and tensor sections are those of [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison].

source.place: Tags 0096 and 01CD; the open-immersion unit comparison, restriction to the top open and the tensor comparison

proof.text: For any module P, compare the standard module-pullback adjunction with the specified tensor-pullback adjunction by uniqueness of left adjoints. The unit of an open immersion is bijective on an open contained in its range. The comparison is an isomorphism, so the specified unit is also bijective. Since a inverse-image U is the top open, the restriction to the top open is an isomorphism. The coefficient map of the scalar inverse-image adjunction is k-linear and agrees with this unit; this gives a scalar-linear isomorphism for P=M tensor N.

Apply module_pullback_tensor to a and compose its coefficient isomorphism with the tensor of the two supplied coefficient isomorphisms. Apply scalarHomApp at the top open to obtain a scalar-linear isomorphism. Compose with the unit-section isomorphism from the previous step. Naturality of the tensor coefficient map commutes with restriction to the top. Its formula on unit tensor sections, tmulSection_map and tensorHom_app_tmulSection give the required formula.

theorem exists_scalarOpenTensorTransport
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (a : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion a] (h : a ≫ f = g)
    (U : X.Opens) (hTop : ⊤ ≤ a ⁻¹ᵁ U) (hRange : U ≤ a.opensRange)
    (M N : X.Modules) (M' N' : Y.Modules)
    (eM : (tensorPullback a).obj M ≅ M')
    (eN : (tensorPullback a).obj N ≅ N') :
    ∃ eT : scalarObj f (show X.Modules from M ⊗ N) (op U) ≅
        scalarObj g (show Y.Modules from M' ⊗ N') (op ⊤),
      ∀ (s : scalarObj f M (op U)) (t : scalarObj f N (op U)),
        eT.hom (tmulSection s t) =
          tmulSection (eM.hom.app ⊤ (tensorPullbackOpenSection a M U hTop s))
            (eN.hom.app ⊤ (tensorPullbackOpenSection a N U hTop t))
